design_gate.question: Can SoilWater(2) delegate only the admitted soil-water solve to reference_richards_legacy_solver_t while preserving SoilWater(3), retry/rollback semantics and continuation state?

control: SW_SOLVE_RETRY_ADVISED maps to existing fldecdt/retry flow; SoilWater(3) must not execute for the rejected solve
accepted nonlinear/backtracking diagnostics may update legacy iteration statistics without becoming committed physical state
solver/interface sensitivity remains result metadata and must not be stored in legacy physical state

reason_not_required: Existing SoilWater(3) recomputes hydraulic conductivities at t+1, groundwater level, profile storage and compartment/boundary flux bookkeeping after the accepted SoilWater(2) solve.

currently_admitted: source/sink provider restricted to its already-qualified inactive-root-extraction scope
restricted_typed_route.rule: F-KT15 must not broaden these scientific/solver admission predicates. Unsupported production states retain the existing legacy HeadCalc route and publish no typed sensitivity.

transaction_rules: Call SoilWaterStateVar(1) exactly once before either solve route.
A typed retry result must enter the existing legacy timestep-reduction/rollback path and cannot publish sensitivity.
Only an accepted typed solve may make its candidate physical postimage visible to SoilWater(3).
SoilWater(3) remains the sole existing owner of post-solve K/Kmean/GWL/storage/flux bookkeeping in this workunit.
No second nonlinear trajectory is permitted for interface sensitivity.
No solver scratch becomes committed column state.
No MODFLOW sign conversion is introduced.
open_implementation_checks: Materialize the already-qualified B1.10 constitutive, fixed-flux top-boundary and source/sink providers from current in-memory state without changing physics.
Define an explicit production route-selection predicate so unsupported cases use the unchanged direct HeadCalc route.
Carry an accepted typed interface sensitivity out of the physical interval to the existing F-KT14 trial_outcome_t bridge without stale values across retries.
Prove baseline identity and hard mass-balance identity in the admitted profile.
Prove unsupported cases are byte/route-equivalent to the unchanged legacy path.
Prove O0/O2 identity and exact-head CI before qualification.
